name: clickflash-ecosystem
description: ClickFlash Photography Ecosystem - 6 apps for professional photographers

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:master" "npm run dev:touch" "npm run dev:management" "npm run dev:gallery" "npm run dev:website" --names "master,touch,management,gallery,website" --prefix-colors "blue,green,purple,pink,cyan"
scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix apps/master install && npm --prefix apps/touch install && npm --prefix apps/management install && npm --prefix apps/gallery install && npm --prefix apps/website install && npm --prefix apps/moneytrash install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:master && npm run build:touch && npm run build:management && npm run build:gallery && npm run build:website
scripts.build:master: npm --prefix apps/master run build && npm --prefix apps/master run build:backend
scripts.build:touch: npm --prefix apps/touch run build && npm --prefix apps/touch run build:backend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:master && npm run test:touch && npm run test:management && npm run test:gallery && npm run test:website && npm run test:moneytrash
scripts.test:ecosystem: npm --prefix apps/master test && npm --prefix apps/management test && npm --prefix apps/gallery test && npm --prefix apps/touch test
scripts.test:ecosystem:coverage: npm --prefix apps/master run test:coverage && npm --prefix apps/management run test:coverage && npm --prefix apps/gallery run test:coverage && npm --prefix apps/touch run test:coverage
scripts.test:ecosystem:ci: npm --prefix apps/master run test:ci && npm --prefix apps/management run test:ci && npm --prefix apps/gallery run test:ci && npm --prefix apps/touch run test:ci
scripts.test:e2e: npx tsx tests/ecosystem/reset.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.ecosystem.config.ts
scripts.lint:all: npm --prefix apps/master run lint && npm --prefix apps/touch run lint && npm --prefix apps/management run lint && npm --prefix apps/gallery run lint && npm --prefix apps/website run lint && npm --prefix apps/moneytrash run lint
scripts.typecheck:all: npm --prefix apps/master run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/touch run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/management run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/gallery run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/website run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/moneytrash run typecheck
